title: Impact Study of Artificial Intelligence, Digital, and Green Economy on the Malaysian Workforce - Global Business Services
evidence_location: Chapter 4, printed pages 38-103 (overall GBS occupational analysis); Finance and Accounting Function roles and skills table, printed page 95

supported_claims.claim: Cost Accountant, Internal Auditor and General Ledger Accountant are included among the medium AI-impacted roles in the GBS finance and accounting function.
supported_claims.evidence_location: Chapter 4, Medium Impacted Roles, printed page 95

supported_claims.claim: The GBS finance and accounting function lists Ethical Judgement, Financial Analysis and Reporting, Attention to Detail, Accounting Principles and Cost-Benefit Analysis as specific skills.
supported_claims.evidence_location: Chapter 4, Finance and Accounting Function skills table, printed page 95

supported_claims.claim: The GBS finance and accounting function lists Influencing and Negotiation, Innovative Thinking, Learning Agility, Planning and Organising, and Conflict Management as basic skills.
supported_claims.evidence_location: Chapter 4, Finance and Accounting Function skills table, printed page 95

limitations: The findings concern the Global Business Services finance and accounting function and do not automatically represent every Accountant and Auditor under MASCO 2411.
The medium AI-impact classification applies to the specified GBS roles, not the entire Accountants and Auditors occupation.
The report does not establish the project's individual skill importance weights of 1 to 4.
notes: The report is publicly accessible, but permission to redistribute or adapt its full contents has not been independently verified.
Source is referenced for factual occupation, skill, and workforce information with attribution.
